The '''bar patrons''' are a group of [[Fallout TV series#Cast and characters|characters]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
These people, along with the [[Bartender (Los Angeles)|bartender]], are present at a bar in [[Los Angeles]] when [[Cooper Howard]] and [[Charles Whiteknife]] meet and talk about the latter's distrust of [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]].

==Appearances==
The unnamed bar patrons appear only {{In|FOTV}}.

{{FOTV appearances|6=106}}

==Behind the scenes==
The characters are portrayed by uncredited extras.
